shared_direction: Photoreal editorial business moment in a warm paper, charcoal, cobalt, coral and amber palette. Keep the human action in the left third and the right 42 percent quiet for the product-node overlay. Natural materials, subtle grain, no readable text, logos, trademarks, watermarks, dashboards, UI, icons, split screens or collages.

store.canonical_prompt: Independent shop owner wrapping a product into a cobalt parcel in a warm tactile studio; shelves, paper and ceramics support the scene; generous quiet wall to the right.

payments.canonical_prompt: Customer presenting a completely blank cobalt card to an independent merchant holding a neutral card terminal at a warm stone counter; no card markings or device branding.

content.canonical_prompt: Creator arranging blank pages and photographic prints around a cobalt folio in a warm studio; clean tabletop with no camera, words, emblems or branded objects.

deliveries.canonical_prompt: Shop owner handing a cobalt parcel with a completely blank white label to a local courier beside a cargo bicycle and plant-filled doorway.

ads.canonical_prompt: Small creative team reviewing an abstract coral, cobalt and stone outdoor set at golden hour, with a camera tripod and blank sculptural billboard surfaces.
